arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -6
import sys, base64, json, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd, subprocess
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload')
line = ','.join(['icmp','x','0','5','put','L','1','0/i1','2001:db8:1:100::1','2001:db8:1:100::1','echo','','',''])
# ~130 MiB of plain text, highly compressible
blob = (HEADER+'\r\n'+ (line+'\r\n')*1500000).encode()
print('plain MB', len(blob)/1e6, file=sys.stderr)
comp = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(blob)
print('compressed MB', len(comp)/1e6, file=sys.stderr)
job = {"version":3,"seed":"s","leases":[{"id":"L","prefix":"2001:db8:1:100::/56","start":0,"end":10,"subnets":[0],"low_count":2}],
       "services":[],"queries":[10],"captures":[{"encoding":"zstd","chunks":[base64.b64encode(comp).decode()]}],
       "requests":[],"offers":[],"request_quotas":[],"offer_quotas":[]}
raw=json.dumps(job).encode()
t=time.time()
done=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],input=raw,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                    preexec_fn=lambda: __import__('resource').setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2*1024**3,2*1024**3)))
print('result', done.stdout[:80], 'rc', done.returncode, '%.1fs'%(time.time()-t), done.stderr[-200:])
print('peak MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024)
PY
